name: Okavo
tagline: A focused marketplace for buyers and identity-checked software developers—without pretending to hold the money.

slides.title: Software work needs clarity before velocity
slides.lead: Okavo creates a structured place to define work, assess people and operate a project—without overstating platform guarantees.

items.title: Lock the scope
items.body: Buyers turn an idea into explicit requirements before comparing bids.

items.title: Make identity visible
items.body: Developers can complete identity checks and capability exams.

items.title: Keep claims honest
items.body: Okavo coordinates the work; it does not claim to hold buyer funds.

slides.title: Four views of one marketplace
slides.lead: Public trust, buying, delivery and platform operations each have a distinct mobile surface.

items.title: Public visitor
items.value: How it works, FAQ, terms, privacy, security and explicit non-guarantees.

items.title: Buyer
items.value: Requirements, projects, developer search, contracts and messages.

items.title: Developer
items.value: Bids, identity upload, exams, contract work and earnings visibility.

items.title: Administrator
items.value: Review queues, account controls, operational actions and audit trails.

slides.title: From requirement to accountable delivery
slides.lead: The product makes each transition visible so participants know what changed and who acts next.
slides.footer: Payments remain disabled until a verified money flow exists

slides.title: Structure the work before choosing the team
slides.lead: Buyers can move from an initial requirement to an operating project without losing the decision trail.

slides.title: Show evidence, submit a bid, deliver the work
slides.lead: Developers get a professional path from identity and capability evidence to proposals, contracts and earnings records.

slides.title: The operating layer behind marketplace trust
slides.lead: Administrators see queues and actions that buyers and developers should never need to understand.

slides.title: Credibility comes from boundaries
slides.lead: Okavo is explicit about what it secures, what it records and what it does not guarantee.

slides.title: A fully native operational shell
slides.lead: Role-sensitive product flows run in React Native while the existing API remains the authoritative business layer.

layers.title: Android + iOS

layers.title: Role-aware shell

layers.title: Device capabilities
layers.body: Secure storage, camera, file picker, downloads and notifications.

layers.title: Existing API

slides.title: Critical roles tested as real mobile paths

slides.title: A serious marketplace in a small-screen format
slides.lead: The mobile product makes Okavo’s strongest idea more accessible: clearly defined work matched with visible evidence.

items.title: Clarity
items.body: Requirements, bids and contracts stay connected to the work.

items.title: Trust
items.body: Identity, roles and audit boundaries are visible without inflated guarantees.

items.title: Mobility
items.body: Messages, files and decisions can move with the people doing the work.
